# My data

```{r}
Country_region <- read.csv("/Users/wenlanzhang/Downloads/PhD_UCL/Data/Oxford/all.csv")

  rename(alpha2 = alpha.2,  # adjust if different name
         region = region,

Country_region
```

```{r}
# --- 0) File paths: adjust if necessary
migrations_file <- "/Users/wenlanzhang/Downloads/PhD_UCL/Data/Oxford/Migration/international_migration_flow.csv"
migrations <- read_csv(migrations_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
migrations
```

```{r}
# Join region & subregion for both "from" and "to"
migrations_joined <- migrations %>%
  left_join(
    Country_region %>%
      select(alpha.2, region, sub.region) %>%
      rename(country_from = alpha.2,
             region_from = region,
             subregion_from = sub.region),
    by = "country_from"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    Country_region %>%
      select(alpha.2, region, sub.region) %>%
      rename(country_to = alpha.2,
             region_to = region,
             subregion_to = sub.region),
    by = "country_to"
  )

# ✅ View the final data
migrations_joined
```


```{r}
# Assuming you already have 'migrations_joined' with region_to, migration_month, num_migrants
inflow_summary <- migrations_joined %>%
  group_by(region_to, migration_month) %>%
  summarise(total_inflow = sum(num_migrants, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

inflow_summary <- inflow_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(region_to) & region_to != "")

inflow_summary
```


```{r}
# Count how many unique regions you have
n_groups <- inflow_summary %>% distinct(region_to) %>% nrow()

# # Get colors from Set2
# pal_nodes <- brewer.pal(n = max(3, min(8, n_groups)), name = "Set2")
# pal_nodes <- rep(pal_nodes, length.out = n_groups)
# pal_nodes <- c("#FC8D62", "#8DA0CB", "#E78AC3", "#A6D854", "#FFD92F")
pal_nodes <- c( '#F0C37E', '#AFDBF4', '#F2C2D8', '#12529A', '#b7a8cf')

# # Define colors
# unikn_cols <- as.character(unlist(pal_unikn_pref[1, ]))
# pal_nodes <- rep(unikn_cols, length.out = n_groups)

# Plot
ggplot(inflow_summary, aes(
  x = as.Date(paste0(migration_month, "-01")),
  y = total_inflow,
  fill = region_to
)) +

  # ---- COVID period shading ----
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2020-03-01"),
    xmax = as.Date("2020-10-01"),
    ymin = 0,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "lightgrey",
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +

  # ---- COVID label ----
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2020-06-15"),
    y = Inf,
    label = "COVID-19",
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 4,
    colour = "grey40"
  ) +

  # ---- main area plot ----
  geom_area(alpha = 0.7, size = 0.5, colour = "white") +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pal_nodes,
    name = "Destination Continent"
  ) +

  theme_ipsum() +

  labs(
    title = "Monthly Migrant Inflows by Destination Continent",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Total inflow"
  ) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),

    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 14,
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 5)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(t = 5)
    ),

    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.box.margin = margin(-10, 0, -30, 0),

    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +

  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

# Save the last plot
ggsave("Result/migrant_time.png", 
       width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
# Plot stacked area chart
ggplot(inflow_summary, aes(x = migration_month, 
                           y = total_inflow, 
                           fill = region_to)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.6, size = 0.5, colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", name = "Destination Region") +
  theme_ipsum() +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Migrant Inflows by Destination Region",
    subtitle = "Stacked area chart representation",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Total inflow"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```

```{r}
# Convert migration_month to Date (if it’s like "2019-01")
inflow_summary <- inflow_summary %>%
  mutate(migration_month = as.Date(paste0(migration_month, "-01")))

# Line plot
ggplot(inflow_summary, aes(x = migration_month, y = total_inflow, color = region_to)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Inflow of Migrants by Destination Region",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Total Inflow",
    color = "Destination Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

```

# example

```{r}
# Packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
 
# create data
time <- as.numeric(rep(seq(1,7),each=7))  # x Axis
value <- runif(49, 10, 100)               # y Axis
group <- rep(LETTERS[1:7],times=7)        # group, one shape per group
data1 <- data.frame(time, value, group)

# stacked area chart
ggplot(data1, aes(x=time, y=value, fill=group)) + 
    geom_area()

```


```{r}
# Give a specific order:
data1$group <- factor(data1$group , levels=c("B", "A", "D", "E", "G", "F", "C") )

# Plot again
ggplot(data1, aes(x=time, y=value, fill=group)) + 
    geom_area()

# Note: you can also sort levels alphabetically:
myLevels <- levels(data1$group)
data1$group <- factor(data1$group , levels=sort(myLevels) )

# Note: sort following values at time = 5
myLevels <- data1 %>%
  filter(time==6) %>%
  arrange(value)
data1$group <- factor(data1$group , levels=myLevels$group )
```

```{r}
# Compute percentages with dplyr
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

data1 <- data1  %>%
  group_by(time, group) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%      # keep 'n' as the summed value
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)                # convert to percentage

# Plot
ggplot(data1, aes(x = time, y = percentage, fill = group)) + 
  geom_area(alpha = 0.6, size = 1, colour = "black")

```


```{r}
# Library
library(viridis)
library(hrbrthemes)

# Plot
ggplot(data1, aes(x=time, y=value, fill=group)) + 
    geom_area(alpha=0.6 , size=.5, colour="white") +
    scale_fill_viridis(discrete = T) +
    theme_ipsum() + 
    ggtitle("The race between ...")
```
